text:
anya.p (partnerships): Heads up — vendor asked for a joint announcement SLA + ops playbook for the H200/B200 co-release. Need to lock timelines for marketplace handoff, gating, and press embargo. Vendor gave a tentative window: week of June 2. Can eng-ops/product/marketing align?

mike.o (eng-ops): Quick Q — what SLOs are they expecting? Our Dedicated cluster currently holds p95 < 120ms in lab for H200 but marketplace onboarding adds cold starts and node churn.

chris.t (product): We need to commit to a rollback & traffic ramp plan. Proposed rollout: canary 10% -> 50% over 24h -> full over 48h with automatic fallback. Also require tagged images: `redwood/h200:vX.Y.Z` and model variant naming convention (h200-prod, h200-lite).

sophia.mkt (marketing): Marketing needs embargo dates + assets timeline. Vendor wants coordinated press. We need at least 2 weeks lead to prepare blog + partner quote + social. Any hard embargo constraints from product/ops?

nate.s (solutions): SI partners will need a pre-onboard checklist: kernel, driver, microcode/firmware versions, quantized builds, and test datasets. I can draft the checklist but need input on exact driver/firmware floors.

mike.o (eng-ops): Ops gating checklist (first pass): node labels, gpu firmware >= 3.2.1, driver >= 535.XX, kernel sanity test, kube-runtime smoke, routing table validations. Also capacity smoke command:
```
# smoke test for marketplace nodes
k8s run --image=redwood/hw-smoke --replicas=10 --labels=marketplace-smoke
```
Add canary autoscaler policy to prevent runaway.

anya.p (partnerships): Vendor asked for SLA during the initial 30-day window: 99.8% availability for marketplace endpoints + 2hr incident response. Is that realistic from ops/product POV?

chris.t (product): 99.8% is doable if we provision warm pools for the first 30 days and keep automatic fallback models ready. Cost impact estimate: ~+18% infra for warm capacity. Need an explicit fallback model (gaudi-lite or smaller) and an automated route for overflow.

sophia.mkt (marketing): :thumbsup: We'll prep messaging for two potential announcement windows (early June and late June). Can someone confirm the final embargo window and the canonical partner contact for press quotes?

mike.o (eng-ops): I'll own the ops playbook draft. Draft runbook snippet for failover below:
```
1) Confirm degraded nodes via /metrics
2) Trigger fallback: `r-infer --fallback gaudi-lite --drain 50%`
3) Scale up warm pool nodes: `infra scale --pool marketplace-warm --count +20`
4) Notify on-call + vendor
```
I'll also add escalation to vendor SRE with 2hr SLA.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled dry run: `h200-marketplace-dryrun` on 4444060000 (2026-05-18T04:00:00Z). Notify #eng-releases if changes needed.

anya.p (partnerships): Action items suggested: nate to produce SI checklist by EOD Thu, mike to produce ops playbook draft by Mon, chris to confirm rollback/traffic policy by Tue, sophia to confirm embargo + assets by Fri. Anyone object or add?

chris.t (product): No objections. Add telemetry requirement: include drift/latency keys and sample dashboards in the playbook so marketing/partners can see health during launch.

nate.s (solutions): Will include quant test matrix and required kernel/driver pins in the checklist.

sophia.mkt (marketing): I'll sync with vendor comms and prepare a partner quote template we can drop into their PR review.

mike.o (eng-ops): Putting a stub PR up: `ops/playbooks/marketplace-h200-core-release.md` with the draft gating checks and runbook.

anya.p (partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll paste this thread into partner channel and tag vendor contact. Please comment in the PRs rather than here for specific infra changes. :handshake:
